description.default: Members decide how next year's discretionary budget is shared across four lines. Every member has as many voice credits as their membership weight, and giving a line n votes costs n² credits, up to 10 votes per line, so a strong preference costs more than broad support. Members who join before the vote closes can take part.

title.default: How many votes do you give each budget line?

description.default: From 0 to 10 votes per line; the squares must add up to at most your voice credits.
